acceptance:
import pytest
from ports import parse_port

def test_valid_and_invalid_ports():
    assert parse_port("8080") == 8080
    assert parse_port(443) == 443
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_port("0")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_port("65536")
